Island 4.1: round 3, subtle bursts

The release bigger than the recap, revealed only by fine lines radiating from it, no colour, no contour, no arrow. Click one for whole, 1/3, 1/20 and beside the other islands. 23 October 2026.

1

The release is drawn bigger than the recap and ringed all the way round by 164 very fine tapered ink rays, evenly spaced, alternating long and short.

2

The release is drawn bigger and a fan of fine tapered ink rays leaves only its side facing the recap, longest and darkest on the line between the two.

3

The release is drawn bigger and surrounded by 21 long, very thin warm-grey rays that swell then taper to hairline tips, longest toward the recap.

4

The release is drawn half again as big and surrounded by two rings of fine tapered ink rays, a dense inner ring of 144 and a fainter outer ring of 36.

5

The release is drawn half again as big and ringed by fine ink rays alternating slim needles and broken three-dash rays, reaching raggedly toward the recap.
